Class MenuRepository

java.lang.Object
com.squad93.pos.db.MenuRepository
public final class MenuRepository extends Object
Menu metadata and recipes are saved atomically; existing sales retain purchase prices.

  • Method Details

    • listAll

      public List<MenuRepository.MenuItem> listAll() throws IOException, SQLException
      Loads all menu items and recipes in one repeatable-read transaction. Unavailable and out-of-season items remain visible to managers.
      Returns:
      an immutable list ordered by name and menu item identifier
      Throws:
      IOException - if database settings cannot be read
      SQLException - if a database operation fails

    • add

      public MenuRepository.MenuItem add(MenuRepository.MenuDraft draft) throws IOException, SQLException
      Inserts menu metadata and its recipe in one transaction.
      Parameters:
      draft - non-null validated details and recipe
      Returns:
      the saved item with its generated identifier
      Throws:
      IOException - if database settings cannot be read
      SQLException - if a database operation fails
      NullPointerException - if the draft is null

    • update

      public MenuRepository.MenuItem update(int menuItemId, MenuRepository.MenuDraft draft) throws IOException, SQLException
      Replaces menu metadata and the entire recipe in one transaction. Previously sold items retain the prices saved on their order lines.
      Parameters:
      menuItemId - positive identifier of the menu item
      draft - non-null validated replacement details
      Returns:
      the saved item
      Throws:
      IOException - if database settings cannot be read
      SQLException - if the item is missing or saving fails
      IllegalArgumentException - if the identifier is not positive
      NullPointerException - if the draft is null

    • delete

      public void delete(int menuItemId) throws IOException, SQLException
      Deletes an unsold menu item and its recipe in one transaction.
      Parameters:
      menuItemId - ID of the menu item to delete
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the ID is not positive
      IOException - if database settings cannot be read
      SQLException - if the item is missing, has sales history, or a database operation fails
